name: adrenolutin
summary: Adrenolutin, also known as 3,5,6-trihydroxy-1-methylindole, is a cyclized derivative of epinephrine (adrenaline) and claimed hallucinogen related to adrenochrome. Along with adrenochrome, adrenolutin is described as an oxidation product of epinephrine. In terms of physical appearance, adrenolutin is described as colorless and as intensely yellow-green fluorescent.

pharmacology.text: Adrenolutin is an analogue of adrenochrome that was claimed to have similar effects. It was said to be as active as adrenochrome but to produce fewer perceptual effects and to have a longer duration or time to recovery.

uses.text: Adrenochrome and adrenolutin were studied by Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond in the 1950s and 1960s.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. The claim that it causes hallucinations rests on a small number of old reports and has not been confirmed. Its risks are unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。關於它會引起幻覺的說法，只建立在少數舊報告上，從未得到證實。它的風險不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。关于它会引起幻觉的说法，只创建在少数旧报告上，从未得到证实。它的风险不明。

fact.en: It is an oxidation product of adrenaline. In the 1950s Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond proposed that such products might cause schizophrenia, an idea the evidence did not support.
fact.zh: 它是腎上腺素的氧化產物。1950年代，Abram Hoffer與Humphry Osmond曾提出這類產物可能造成精神分裂症，但證據並不支持這個想法。
fact.zhHans: 它是肾上腺素的氧化产物。1950年代，Abram Hoffer与Humphry Osmond曾提出这类产物可能造成精神分裂症，但证据并不支持这个想法。
